dataset.name: PLANet resected hepatocellular carcinoma cohort (2024)
dataset.description: Independent bulk RNA-seq from spatially sampled, resected hepatocellular carcinomas in the Asia-Pacific PLANet cohort, linked to individual time-to-recurrence follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The publication included 123 early-to-intermediate-stage HCC patients. TRACE Explorer retains one expression-complete tumor region per patient using total raw-count library size before reading the outcome; 109 selected patients have positive time-to-recurrence follow-up.
dataset.publication_citation: Chen et al. Journal of Hepatology 2024

metadata.source_program: Precision Medicine in Liver Cancer across an Asia-Pacific Network (PLANet; NCT03267641)
metadata.source_data_system: Zenodo source-data record plus the pinned publisher clinical supplement
metadata.library_method: featureCounts raw gene counts normalized by TRACE Explorer to log2(CPM + 1)
metadata.curation_note: Only exact patient-region identifiers present in both the publication sample map and the count matrix are eligible. One region is selected per patient by greatest total raw-count library size, with lexical sample ID as the deterministic tie-breaker; the rule does not use recurrence.
metadata.endpoint_note: TTR is time from surgery to documented recurrence. It is not relabelled as recurrence-free survival because the source endpoint does not count death without recurrence as an event.
metadata.redistribution_note: The Zenodo expression archive is CC BY 4.0, while the publisher clinical supplement is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. TRACE Explorer permits analysis but disables direct matrix downloads and does not represent the combined derivative as freely redistributable.

samples.sample_role: One outcome-independent tumor RNA profile per resected HCC patient

expression.label: PLANet counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GENCODE v33 gene_name values supplied in the pinned PLANet featureCounts matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated supplied gene symbols are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous source-level rule.
expression.scale_note: Library size is calculated across all source gene rows for the selected tumor region, followed by counts per million and log2(CPM + 1).

endpoints.label: Time to recurrence after resection
endpoints.time_origin: Date of surgery for the profiled resected tumor
endpoints.event_definition: Documented tumor recurrence (source TTR.status = 1); source TTR.status = 0 is censored
